patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes the screen capture block so screenshots and recordings work.

patches.name: Enable 30-day Resto reservations
patches.description: Allows reserving Resto meals up to 30 days in advance.

patches.name: Fix screen freeze
patches.description: Fixes screen freezing after resuming the app from the background.

patches.name: Remove PairIP protection
patches.description: Removes Google Play's PairIP anti-tamper wrapper so the app runs without license checks. Restores the original Application class in the manifest, removes all injected com.pairip.* components, and neuters PairIP's license client.

patches.name: Disable Play Integrity
patches.description: Short-circuits the Google Play Integrity attestation request with a "DISABLED" response, avoiding failures on modified or non-Play builds.

patches.name: Disable developer options detection
patches.description: Stops the app from detecting that Developer Options or USB debugging are enabled on the device, removing the blocking security dialog.

patches.name: Disable root & emulator detection
patches.description: Forces every root, jailbreak, emulator and frida check in the app to report a clean device, so no blocking dialog is shown on modified/rooted environments.

patches.name: Remove CleverTap tracking
patches.description: Removes CleverTap analytics initialization, stopping the app from collecting the phone number as an identity key and from reporting usage data.

patches.name: Bypass certificate checks
patches.description: Bypasses certificate pinning so intercepted TLS connections are accepted.

patches.name: Disable analytics and crash reporting
patches.description: Disables analytics and crash reporting while keeping push notifications.

patches.name: Disable root detection
patches.description: Disables the rooted-device check so the app runs on rooted devices.
